PHOTOS: The first Stonewall Philippines Pride march commences today, June 26, coinciding with the 31st anniversary of ‘Stonewall Manila,’ the first Pride march held in the Philippines. 

Groups held the program along Recto Ave. after police in riot gear barred the march going to the  Mendiola Peace Arch. 

Various sectors are present to show solidarity to the Filipino queer community. Calls for genuine gender equality, poverty alleviation, and ending wars and government corruption are highlighted in the protest today.
